mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.address_id, o.order_sn, o.payment_sn, o.total_amount, o.pay_method, o.express_delivery, o.status, o.recipient_name, o.recipient_phone, o.recipient_address, o.payment_time, o.delivery_time, o.receipt_time, o.seckill_session_id, o.create_time, o.update_time, u.name AS user_name, oi.id AS item_id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.product_price, oi.product_img, oi.amount FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN oms_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.address_id, o.order_sn, o.payment_sn, o.total_amount, o.pay_method, o.express_delivery, o.status, o.recipient_name, o.recipient_phone, o.recipient_address, o.payment_time, o.delivery_time, o.receipt_time, o.seckill_session_id, o.create_time, o.update_time, u.name AS user_name, oi.id AS item_id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.product_price, oi.product_img, oi.amount FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN oms_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(create_time AS DATE) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS sales FROM oms_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY CAST(create_time AS DATE) ORDER BY `date` ASC

SELECT c.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(oi.amount), 0) AS `count` FROM oms_order_item oi INNER JOIN oms_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = oi.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN pms_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE oi.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY `count` DESC
